value.signature: fn initial_asset_id (display_txid : [u8 ; 32] , index : u32 , contract : [u8 ; 32]) -> Result < AssetId , RecipeError >

review.body: { if index & 0xc000_0000 != 0 { return Err (RecipeError :: PrevoutIndex) ; } let mut prevout = [0_u8 ; 36] ; let mut consensus_txid = display_txid ; consensus_txid . reverse () ; prevout [.. 32] . copy_from_slice (& consensus_txid) ; prevout [32 ..] . copy_from_slice (& index . to_le_bytes ()) ; let hash = Sha256 :: digest (Sha256 :: digest (prevout)) ; let entropy = midpoint (hash . into () , contract) ; let mut asset = midpoint (entropy , [0 ; 32]) ; asset . reverse () ; Ok (AssetId (asset)) }
review.item_premise: Every argument and result is public and recorded in full. The byte recipes claim only their derivations; parsing precedes membership hashing, fixed message/signature lengths precede native verification, and no chain or complete act verdict is produced.
